tasks.prompt: You are taking a psychology course taught by Professor Schulz. You have missed several classes and have difficulty understanding the required reading materials. You are worried that you will fail the course and would like to ask the professor for help and advice.
bullets: ●  Explain why you are struggling with the course.
●  Describe what you have already done to try to improve.
●  Request a meeting to discuss the situation in person.
tasks.subject: Request for additional support

tasks.instruction:
In your response, you should do the following.
   ●  Express and support your opinion.
   ●  Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Achebe
professor.text: Throughout history, artists have used their work to challenge societal norms and traditions as well as provoke thought. Some people believe that art should always aim to inspire and uplift, while others think it should confront and disrupt the status quo and stereotypes. What purpose do you think art should serve in society?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I believe art should inspire and uplift. In a world filled with challenges, art has the power to bring joy and hope to people who may need to escape from the pressures of everyday life. Art that is uplifting can improve a person’s mental health.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I think art should confront and disrupt long held but outdated traditions and norms. Art has the ability to provoke thought and challenge people to see things from different perspectives. By addressing societal issues, art can drive change and promote progress.
